title: Bothela's Discreet Delivery
description: Bothela at The Hag's Cure in Markarth asks you to deliver a discreet Stallion's Potion to the Jarl's steward, Raerek, in Understone Keep.

base_facts: I run The Hag's Cure, an alchemy shop in Markarth just west of Cidhna Mine.
The people of Markarth come to me secretly for cures and potions they don't want others knowing about.
I have a Stallion's Potion that needs delivering to the Jarl's steward.

BOTHELAS_DISCREET_DELIVERY_INFO: I've asked someone to deliver the Stallion's Potion to the steward for me.
BOTHELAS_DISCREET_DELIVERY_ACCEPT: My courier has agreed to deliver the Stallion's Potion to the steward.
Player accepts the delivery task. Stallion's Potion is added to inventory and quest is set.
Some gold for your assistance and your, discretion." After speaking with him, the Stallion's Potion will be removed from your inventory and Raerek will reward you with a leveled amount of gold.

The Stallion's Potion is marked as stolen when it is in your inventory, which means if you get arrested and decide to pay off your bounty or go to jail, it will disappear from your inventory and the quest will get stuck.

base_facts: I am the steward of Markarth, found in Understone Keep.

beats.comment: Bothela mentions she has a potion for the steward that needs delivering discreetly.
Player accepts the delivery task. Stallion's Potion is added to inventory and quest stage 10 is set.
